executive_summary:
# Agent N's Hermes News — 2026-09-24

**Executive summary:** The week's headline is the **Bot Screen** launch in **Hermes Desktop** — real-time streaming of agent sessions plus visual and interactive passthrough, one of the most requested Hermes capabilities to date. Beyond the launch, a third-party ecosystem is clearly forming: **jeval** was open-sourced for JEV evaluation, and **oh-my-hermes** shipped JEV skills and model routing. Maintainers stayed visibly hands-on (including a fast bug fix and an attribution correction), while practical tips like running **Hermes via iMessage** rounded out the conversation.

## Releases

**Bot Screen — watch your agents work live in Hermes Desktop.** **@NousResearch** officially launched [**Bot Screen**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-ef6b4179c4fa), enabling real-time streaming of any bot session so you can watch your **Hermes Agent** drive a browser or terminal live. Co-founder **@Teknium** followed with the companion capability users really wanted: [visual and interactive passthrough](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-4784626f2a61) to the same machine the agent controls — the community's biggest post of the week at ~1,046 likes. [Official docs](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d84a2bc0a85d) landed with a strong 488 likes. Sentiment was strongly positive and anticipatory — Teknium's own ["Finallllly!"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-014ad26a44c6) (69 likes / 4.3k views) and a ["Much needed!"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-48968e1c836e) reply (189 likes / 18.6k views) confirm this was one of the most requested Hermes capabilities.

## Community

**Third-party tooling is maturing.** **@rlaope** had a productive week: [open-sourcing **jeval**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-99948938337f) for **JEV** model evaluation and visualization, plus an [**oh-my-hermes** update adding **JEV skills** and **model routing**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-415aecf318f8) across models/aliases, skills/plugins, and workflow decisions. **OMH** is now positioned as the ["all-in-one plugin for AI-native"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-b4d141253a4f) **Hermes Agent** users — a clear signal that a third-party ecosystem is forming around the Hermes platform.

**Maintainers stayed hands-on.** **@Teknium** was active in the replies all week: he [pushed back on a claimed cache bug](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d5a2f794eeec) by requesting a reproducible issue path, [confirmed a fast fix](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-3e1742f36c0b) once user feedback arrived, and [corrected misattribution](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-992950038a21) by clarifying that a circulating tool was built by **@NousResearch**, not Anthropic. Overall read: responsive, opinionated maintainership with only minor public friction.

**Community demos drew ["Impressive!"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-015fe011793b) reactions**, rounding out the Bot Screen launch excitement.

## Tips & Tutorials

**Run Hermes via iMessage.** An official tip confirms you can run [**Hermes via iMessage**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-768697783517) with any model of your choice — handy for driving agents straight from your phone.

**Get started with Bot Screen.** **@tonbistudio** produced the [walkthrough video](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d03d44ef66a9) for the launch, amplified by the official account, and community reaction to the new [guide video](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-b1cd1c2e155e) was warm if casual. If you're setting up Bot Screen this week, start there.

# Agent N's Hermes News — 2026-09-24

Executive summary: The week's headline is the Bot Screen launch in Hermes Desktop — real-time streaming of agent sessions plus visual and interactive passthrough, one of the most requested Hermes capabilities to date. Beyond the launch, a third-party ecosystem is clearly forming: jeval was open-sourced for JEV evaluation, and oh-my-hermes shipped JEV skills and model routing. Maintainers stayed visibly hands-on (including a fast bug fix and an attribution correction), while practical tips like running Hermes via iMessage rounded out the conversation.

Releases

Bot Screen — watch your agents work live in Hermes Desktop. @NousResearch officially launched Bot Screen, enabling real-time streaming of any bot session so you can watch your Hermes Agent drive a browser or terminal live. Co-founder @Teknium followed with the companion capability users really wanted: visual and interactive passthrough to the same machine the agent controls — the community's biggest post of the week at ~1,046 likes. Official docs landed with a strong 488 likes. Sentiment was strongly positive and anticipatory — Teknium's own "Finallllly!" (69 likes / 4.3k views) and a "Much needed!" reply (189 likes / 18.6k views) confirm this was one of the most requested Hermes capabilities.

Community

Third-party tooling is maturing. @rlaope had a productive week: open-sourcing jeval for JEV model evaluation and visualization, plus an oh-my-hermes update adding JEV skills and model routing across models/aliases, skills/plugins, and workflow decisions. OMH is now positioned as the "all-in-one plugin for AI-native" Hermes Agent users — a clear signal that a third-party ecosystem is forming around the Hermes platform.

Maintainers stayed hands-on. @Teknium was active in the replies all week: he pushed back on a claimed cache bug by requesting a reproducible issue path, confirmed a fast fix once user feedback arrived, and corrected misattribution by clarifying that a circulating tool was built by @NousResearch, not Anthropic. Overall read: responsive, opinionated maintainership with only minor public friction.

Community demos drew "Impressive!" reactions, rounding out the Bot Screen launch excitement.

Tips & Tutorials

Run Hermes via iMessage. An official tip confirms you can run Hermes via iMessage with any model of your choice — handy for driving agents straight from your phone.

Get started with Bot Screen. @tonbistudio produced the walkthrough video for the launch, amplified by the official account, and community reaction to the new guide video was warm if casual. If you're setting up Bot Screen this week, start there.
